# automate-glama-submit

> Bulk-submit all your MCP server repos to glama.ai in one command.

automate-glama-submit is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/automate-glama-submit/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
